parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. On the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console, you can view the **ID** of the current instance.

><notice>
- If this value exists, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If no <props="intl"><ph>**Overview** page or </ph></props>ID value exists, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。

><notice>
- 若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
- 若无<props="intl"><ph>**实例概览**页面或</ph></props>ID值，则无需传入。

></notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the update package. The ID uniquely identifies the update package.

The update package ID is one of the parameters returned when you call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/147311.html to create the update package.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/147450.html to view the update package ID from the response parameters
parameters.help_zh:
升级包ID，升级包的唯一标识符。

升级包ID是调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/147311.html创建升级包时，返回的参数之一。

可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/147450.html，从返回参数中查看
parameters.name: firmware_id

parameters.help_en: The **ProductKey** of the product to which the update package belongs
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.help_en:
The automatic retry interval after a device fails to be updated. Unit: minutes. Valid values:

- **0**: retries immediately.
- **10**: retries after 10 minutes.
- **30**: retries after 30 minutes.
- **60**: retries after 60 minutes (1 hour).
- **1440**: retries after 1,440 minutes (24 hours).

><notice> The value of **RetryInterval** must be less than the value of **TimeoutInMinutes**. Examples:
- If the value of **TimeoutInMinutes** is 60 minutes, the maximum value of **RetryInterval** is 30.
- If the value of **TimeoutInMinutes** is 1440 minutes, the maximum value of **RetryInterval** is 60.

If you want to set **RetryInterval** to retry after 24 hours, do not specify **TimeoutInMinutes**. After the update times out, no retry is triggered.
></notice>

If you do not specify this parameter, no retry is performed
parameters.help_zh:
设备升级失败后，自动重试的时间间隔，单位为分钟。可选值：

- **0**：立即重试。
- **10**：10分钟后重试。
- **30**：30分钟后重试。
- **60**：60分钟（即1小时）后重试。
- **1440**：1,440分钟（即24小时）后重试。

><notice> **RetryInterval**的值需要小于**TimeoutInMinutes**的值。例如：
- **TimeoutInMinutes**的值为60分钟，**RetryInterval**的值最大可设置为30。
- **TimeoutInMinutes**的值为1440分钟，**RetryInterval**的值最大可设置为60。

若**RetryInterval**需设置为24小时后重试，则建议不传入**TimeoutInMinutes**。因升级超时后，不会再触发升级重试。
></notice>

不传入此参数，则表示不重试
parameters.name: retry_interval

parameters.help_en:
The number of automatic retries.

If you specify the **RetryInterval** parameter, you must specify this parameter.

Valid values:

- **1**: 1 time.
- **2**: 2 times.
- **5**: 5 times
parameters.help_zh:
自动重试次数。

如果传入**RetryInterval**参数，则需传入该参数。

可选值：

- **1**：1次。
- **2**：2次。
- **5**：5次
parameters.name: retry_count

parameters.help_en:
The timeout period for the device update. If the device does not complete the update within the specified period, the update fails. Unit: minutes. Valid values: 1 to 1440.

> - The timeout period starts from the time when the device first reports the update progress. If the device goes online and offline multiple times during the update, which triggers IoT Platform to push the update package multiple times, the start time is always the time when the device first reports the update progress.
- An update failure caused by a timeout does not trigger the automatic retry logic.




If you do not specify this parameter, no timeout limit is imposed on the device update
parameters.help_zh:
设备升级超时时间，超过指定时间后，设备未完成升级，则升级失败。单位为分钟，取值范围为1~1,440。

> - 从设备首次上报进度开始计算时间。升级期间若设备多次上下线，触发物联网平台多次推送升级包，都始终以设备最开始的第一次上报升级进度时间作为开始时间。
- 因超时而导致的升级失败，物联网平台不会触发自动重试逻辑。




不传入该参数，则表示设备升级没有超时限制
parameters.name: timeout_in_minutes

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of devices to which the download URL of the update package is pushed per minute. Valid values: 10 to 10000.

If you do not specify this parameter, the default value 10000 is used
parameters.help_zh:
每分钟最多向多少个设备推升级包下载URL。取值范围：10~10,000。

不传入该参数，则取默认值10,000
parameters.name: maximum_per_minute

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to overwrite the previous update task. Valid values:

- **1** (default): does not overwrite. If the device already has an update task, only the existing task is performed.
- **2**: overwrites. The device performs only the new update task. In this case, **MultiModuleMode** cannot be set to **true**.

> Update tasks that are in progress are not overwritten
parameters.help_zh:
是否覆盖之前的升级任务。取值：

- **1**（默认）：不覆盖。若设备已有升级任务，则只执行已有任务。
- **2**：覆盖。设备只执行新的升级任务。此时**MultiModuleMode**不能传入**true**。

> 不覆盖升级中的任务
parameters.name: overwrite_mode

parameters.help_en:
The dynamic update mode. Valid values:

- **1** (default): updates devices that currently meet the update conditions and continuously checks whether devices meet the update conditions to update eligible devices.

- **2**: takes effect only on devices that subsequently report new version numbers
parameters.help_zh:
动态升级模式。取值范围：

- **1**（默认）：除了升级当前满足升级条件的设备，还将持续检查设备是否满足升级条件，对满足升级条件的设备进行升级。

- **2**：仅对后续上报新版本号的设备生效
parameters.name: dynamic_mode

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether IoT Platform proactively pushes over-the-air update task to devices.

- **true** (default): yes. After the batch task is created, IoT Platform proactively pushes over-the-air update task to online devices within over-the-air update scope.
    
    In this case, devices can still proactively send requests to IoT Platform to obtain OTA update task information.

- **false**: no. Devices must send requests to IoT Platform to obtain OTA update task information
parameters.help_zh:
物联网平台是否主动向设备推送升级任务。

- **true**（默认）：是。批次任务创建完成后，物联网平台主动将升级任务，直接推送给升级范围内的在线设备。
    
    此时，设备仍可主动向物联网平台发起请求，来获取OTA升级任务信息。

- **false**：否。设备必须通过向物联网平台发起请求，来获取OTA升级任务信息
parameters.name: need_push

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to control the OTA upgrade of a device by using a mobile app that you develop. You can use this parameter to allow the mobile app to determine whether the device can perform an over-the-air update.


- **false** (default): no. The OTA upgrade node information is obtained based on the **NeedPush** Settings.
- **true**: yes. The device cannot obtain the OTA upgrade node. After the over-the-air update is confirmed on the app side, the OTA upgrade node information is obtained based on the **NeedPush** Settings
parameters.help_zh:
如需自主控制设备OTA升级时，可配置此参数，通过手机App来控制，设备是否可进行OTA升级。手机App需您自行开发。


- **false**（默认）：否。直接按照**NeedPush**设置，获取OTA升级任务信息。
- **true**：是。设备无法获取OTA升级任务，需App侧确认OTA升级后，才能按照**NeedPush**设置，获取OTA升级任务信息
parameters.name: need_confirm

parameters.help_en:
The group ID.

- If you specify this parameter, you must also specify **GroupType** and cannot specify **SrcVersion.N**.
- If you do not specify this parameter, you do not need to specify **GroupType** and must specify **SrcVersion.N**.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/93356.html to query the group ID (**GroupId**)
parameters.help_zh:
分组ID。

- 如果传入该参数，则必须同时传入**GroupType**，且不能传入**SrcVersion.N**。
- 如果不传入该参数，则无需传入**GroupType**，且必须传入**SrcVersion.N**。

您可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/93356.html接口查询分组ID（**GroupId**）
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.help_en:
The group type. The only valid value is **LINK_PLATFORM_DYNAMIC** (dynamic group).

- If you specify this parameter, you must also specify **GroupId** and cannot specify **SrcVersion.N**.
- If you do not specify this parameter, you do not need to specify **GroupId** and must specify **SrcVersion.N**
parameters.help_zh:
分组类型，仅可取值**LINK_PLATFORM_DYNAMIC**（动态分组）。

- 如果传入该参数，则必须同时传入**GroupId**，且不能传入**SrcVersion.N**。
- 如果不传入该参数，则无需传入**GroupId**，且必须传入**SrcVersion.N**
parameters.name: group_type

parameters.help_en:
The protocol used to download over-the-air update package. Valid values: **HTTPS** (default) and **MQTT**. After the device receives over-the-air update package download information pushed by IoT Platform, the device uses this protocol to download over-the-air update package.

><notice>To use the MQTT protocol to download over-the-air update package, the following conditions must be met:
- Supported regions: only China (Shanghai), China (Beijing), and China (Shenzhen).
- OTA update package: contains only one file, and the file size does not exceed 16 MB.
- Device SDK: you must use the latest version of the C language Link SDK provided by IoT Platform to develop OTA update and MQTT file download capabilities. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/330985.html.

></notice>
parameters.help_zh:
升级包下载协议，可选：**HTTPS**（默认）或**MQTT**。设备端收到物联网平台推送的升级包下载信息后，通过该协议下载升级包。

><notice>使用MQTT协议下载升级包，必须符合以下条件：
- 支持的地域：仅中国的华东2（上海）、华北2（北京）和华南1（深圳）。
- OTA升级包：仅包含一个文件，且文件大小不超过16 MB。
- 设备端SDK：必须使用物联网平台提供的C语言Link SDK最新版本的软件包，开发OTA升级和MQTT下载文件的能力。详细内容，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/330985.html。

></notice>
parameters.name: download_protocol

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the device supports simultaneous multi-module upgrades.

- **false** (default): no. The device does not support simultaneous multi-module upgrades.
- **true**: yes. The device supports simultaneous multi-module upgrades. In this case, **OverwriteMode** cannot be set to **2**. Upgrade nodes for the same module are overwritten, but upgrade nodes that are in progress are not overwritten.

><notice>
- Supported instances: Enterprise instances and new public instances.
- Device SDK: you must use the 4.x version of the C language Link SDK provided by IoT Platform.
- When initiating a group-based dynamic upgrade batch: the settings of **MultiModuleMode** and **OverwriteMode** must be consistent with the settings in the existing dynamic upgrade batch for the group.

></notice>

For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/58328.html
parameters.help_zh:
设备是否支持多模块同时升级。

- **false**（默认）：否，设备不支持多模块同时升级。
- **true**：是，设备支持多模块同时升级。此时**OverwriteMode**不能传入**2**。相同模块下的升级任务会被覆盖，但不覆盖升级中的任务。

><notice>
- 支持的实例：企业版实例和新版公共实例。
- 设备端SDK：必须使用物联网平台提供的设备端C语言4.x版本的Link SDK。
- 发起基于分组的动态升级批次：**MultiModuleMode**和**OverwriteMode**的设置，必须与分组对应的存量动态升级批次中的设置保持一致。

></notice>

更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/58328.html
parameters.name: multi_module_mode

parameters.help_en:
The list of firmware versions to be updated.

- If you specify this parameter, you cannot specify **GroupId** or **GroupType**.
- If you do not specify this parameter, you must specify **GroupId** and **GroupType**.

> - When you initiate a dynamic update task for a delta update package based on versions, the value of this parameter must be the same as the source version (**SrcVersion**) of the delta update package.
When you initiate a dynamic update task for a delta update package based on a dynamic group, you do not need to specify this parameter.
- You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69594.html to view the OTA module version **FirmwareVersion** of the device.
- The list cannot contain duplicate version numbers.
- A maximum of 10 version numbers can be specified
parameters.help_zh:
待升级版本号列表。

- 如果传入该参数，则不能传入**GroupId**和**GroupType**。
- 如果不传入该参数，则必须传入**GroupId**和**GroupType**。

> - 基于版本对差分升级包发起动态升级任务时，该参数值必须与差分升级包的待升级版本号（**SrcVersion**）相同。
基于动态分组对差分升级包发起动态升级任务时，无需传入该参数。
- 可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69594.html，查看设备OTA模块版本号**FirmwareVersion**。
- 列表中不能有重复的版本号。
- 最多可传入10个版本号
parameters.name: src_version

element_fields.help_en:
The key of the batch tag. Only letters, digits, and periods (.) are supported. The key must be 1 to 30 characters in length. A maximum of 10 batch tags can be added.

Batch tags are sent to the device when IoT Platform pushes the update notification to the device.

> Batch tags are optional. The **Required** column shows **Yes** because if you specify a batch tag (Tag), **Tag.N.Value** and **Tag.N.Key** must be specified in pairs
element_fields.help_zh:
批次标签key。仅支持英文字母、数字、半角句号（.），长度限制为1~30个字符。支持最多添加10个批次标签。

批次标签将在向设备推送升级通知时下发给设备。

> 批次标签可以不传入。**是否必选**的**是**，表示如果传入批次标签Tag，**Tag.N.Value**与**Tag.N.Key**必须成对传入
element_fields.name: key

element_fields.help_en:
The value of the batch tag. The value must be 1 to 1024 characters in length. A maximum of 10 batch tags can be added. The total length of all batch tag keys and values cannot exceed 4096 characters.


> Batch tags are optional. The **Required** column shows **Yes** because if you specify a batch tag (Tag), **Tag.N.Value** and **Tag.N.Key** must be specified in pairs
element_fields.help_zh:
批次标签value。长度限制为1~1024个字符。支持最多添加10个批次标签。所有批次标签key和vlaue的长度总和，不能超过4096个字符。


> 批次标签可以不传入。**是否必选**的**是**，表示如果传入批次标签Tag，**Tag.N.Value**与**Tag.N.Key**必须成对传入
element_fields.name: value
